goal: Prevent peers from bypassing inbound tx-relay capacity limits by requesting BIP35 mempool inventory
Ignore mempool requests from peers with tx relay disabled unless granted explicit mempool permission
agreement: Nobody has spoken in explicit support yet, though objections have been addressed
Resolved concern: earlier revision could flood fRelay=false peers with unfiltered invs (darosior)
Resolved objection: fRelay=false peers should not be allowed mempool inventory (gmaxwell)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents inbound peers on bloom-enabled nodes from evading tx-relay limits via BIP35
Plugs a resource-accounting evasion hole to improve peer-to-peer DoS resistance
